report.summary: The hypothesis that security specialists and IT executives from the corporate sector are concerned about data leaks when using LLM at work is supported by comments from professional communities, where users express fear of leaks and fines, and a desire to discuss security issues to stay aware of threats and solutions. However, the assumption that at least 30 participants will fill out the questionnaire within 72 hours is uncertain, as only 6 comments from source_1 and 15 comments from source_2 mention the survey, while 90 comments from source_3 do not mention it. The comments also suggest that users are interested in discussing security issues, but the willingness to participate in an anonymous survey is unclear.
recommendations: Conduct a survey or short questionnaire on willingness and expectations to test the assumption that at least 30 security specialists and IT executives will fill out the questionnaire within 72 hours.
Post in professional communities with a call to take an anonymous survey and offer to share the survey results with all participants to gauge interest and willingness to participate.
Consider offering incentives or rewards for participating in the survey to increase response rates.
Analyze the comments from source_3 to understand the reasons why users are not mentioning the survey and adjust the approach accordingly.
